LOCAL GPL PROTOTYPE ONLY - NOT RELEASE CLEARED

The linked playback stack includes GPL components such as mpv/FFmpeg/rubberband.
ISC permissions in the API headers do not change the linked runtime's licenses.
This bootstrap extracts only the dependency closure of IINA's official libmpv.
IINA UI, assets, Sparkle, and IINA executable are not copied or launched.
The original upstream license texts saved here are an initial notice set, not
a complete per-library license/copyright audit or corresponding-source archive.
Before any distribution, inventory every bundled library; preserve all notices;
provide complete corresponding source and build/patch scripts as required;
and confirm GPL compatibility for the whole application. Closed-source
compatibility is not claimed. This bundle is not approved for App Store release.
